title: Promote organizations to staging and production
description:
Phase 7. Strictly sequential, and last.

Staging and production are dark for the duration of this initiative, taken down in 7c1382, and come back only with authentication in front of them. Each redeploy is followed by live acceptance against that named environment from a logged-in shell, never from GitHub Actions.

bc830a returns staging, then 89a222 deploys production as a separate deploy of a staging-proven release.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Children bc830a and 89a222 closed: staging and production redeployed behind auth. Live-accept with CHATTICUS_LIVE_ID_TOKEN remains human-gated on ecf0ca.
